error: error: Failed to create virtual environment
why: Our script recreated /work/.venv, which the harness already provides, without clearing it, so uv refused; the README itself was never reached.
fix:
uv venv --clear --python 3.10 /work/.venv  # prereq docs/installation_guide.md:L6 "3.7 - 3.10"
source /work/.venv/bin/activate  # prereq docs/installation_guide.md:L6 "3.7 - 3.10"
